$description: Domain template for the Hate Speech Criteria (HSC) aspects, inspired by notes.md and Khurana et al. (2022). Each definition file (e.g. hatecheck.json) should mirror this structure and fill in `selected` (and sub-fields where applicable) using values drawn from the corresponding `domain` lists. Values not foreseen here can be added under an `others` entry.

target_groups.description: Person or group from a specific protected identity that is considered a potential target of hate speech.

dominance.description: Are dominant groups also considered alongside non-dominant groups as potential targets?

enable.description: Whether the definition allows dominant groups to be targets of hate speech.

groups.description: Dominant groups that the definition explicitly mentions as potential targets.

explicit_reference.description: Presence of an explicit reference to the target group, related to the target(s) above.

effects_consequences.description: Potential effects or consequences of the utterance that the definition treats as constitutive of hate speech.
